members.name: add
members.doc: Return a fragment which is the addition of the two samples passed as parameters.

members.name: adpcm2lin
members.doc: Decode an Intel/DVI ADPCM coded fragment to a linear fragment.

members.name: alaw2lin
members.doc: Convert sound fragments in a-LAW encoding to linearly encoded sound fragments.

members.name: avg
members.doc: Return the average over all samples in the fragment.

members.name: avgpp
members.doc: Return the average peak-peak value over all samples in the fragment.

members.name: bias
members.doc: Return a fragment that is the original fragment with a bias added to each sample.

members.name: byteswap
members.doc: Convert big-endian samples to little-endian and vice versa.

members.name: cross
members.doc: Return the number of zero crossings in the fragment passed as an argument.

members.name: error
members.doc: Common base class for all non-exit exceptions.

members.name: findfactor
members.doc: Return a factor F such that rms(add(fragment, mul(reference, -F))) is minimal.

members.name: findfit
members.doc: Try to match reference as well as possible to a portion of fragment.

members.name: findmax
members.doc: Search fragment for a slice of specified number of samples with maximum energy.

members.name: getsample
members.doc: Return the value of sample index from the fragment.

members.name: lin2adpcm
members.doc: Convert samples to 4 bit Intel/DVI ADPCM encoding.

members.name: lin2alaw
members.doc: Convert samples in the audio fragment to a-LAW encoding.

members.name: lin2lin
members.doc: Convert samples between 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-byte formats.

members.name: lin2ulaw
members.doc: Convert samples in the audio fragment to u-LAW encoding.

members.name: max
members.doc: Return the maximum of the absolute value of all samples in a fragment.

members.name: maxpp
members.doc: Return the maximum peak-peak value in the sound fragment.

members.name: minmax
members.doc: Return the minimum and maximum values of all samples in the sound fragment.

members.name: mul
members.doc: Return a fragment that has all samples in the original fragment multiplied by the floating-point value factor.

members.name: ratecv
members.signature: (fragment, width, nchannels, inrate, outrate, state, weightA=1, weightB=0, /)
members.doc: Convert the frame rate of the input fragment.

members.name: reverse
members.doc: Reverse the samples in a fragment and returns the modified fragment.

members.name: rms
members.doc: Return the root-mean-square of the fragment, i.e. sqrt(sum(S_i^2)/n).

members.name: tomono
members.doc: Convert a stereo fragment to a mono fragment.

members.name: tostereo
members.doc: Generate a stereo fragment from a mono fragment.

members.name: ulaw2lin
members.doc: Convert sound fragments in u-LAW encoding to linearly encoded sound fragments.
